claims.statement: SilverSea is a pnpm monorepo: Express+TS backend on port 3001, React 19+Vite frontend on strictPort 7174, shared @tingting/shared package; backend/src/services holds 214 service modules and runs on Drizzle/Postgres with JWT+Casbin RBAC.
Financial precision is centralized in shared/src/calculations (round2dp, computeTripTotals); VND amounts carry no decimals and both apps share these functions.

frontend structure.guard.test.ts freezes per-file line ceilings (ratchet only shrinks); when branches independently grow a file, the ceiling is bumped to the actual merged line count with a comment naming both feature sets.
After editing shared/src, compiled shared/dist must be rebuilt (pnpm --dir shared build) or backend imports fail at runtime.
Report-cache invalidators exist in 3 copies; a new ledger-report pattern must be wired into all of them.
